subject: Draft risk list: call recording coaching
mail: Here's the risk list for the pilot where supervisors coach agents using recorded calls. I've tried to be thorough. Anything wrong before it goes to the contact centre manager?
snippets: Calls are already recorded for quality checks.
The company has a works council and a DPO.
draft_title: Risks and dependencies: coaching on recorded calls
draft: DPO: using recordings for coaching is a new purpose for personal data; agree purpose, retention and access before the pilot.
Works council: coaching on recordings can be seen as monitoring; present the plan and get agreement before launch.
Supervisor time: each session takes 20 minutes; lower the supervisors' own call targets during the pilot.
Agent trust: agents may feel watched; in the first month, agents choose which of their own calls to discuss.
IT: the recording tool must let supervisors tag calls for coaching; confirm with the vendor before fixing a start date.
Customers: the recorded greeting already mentions training purposes; legal confirms it covers coaching.
flaw_why: There is no wrong line: every risk is specific to this pilot and has a concrete mitigation.
fix: No fix needed; send it as it is.
debrief: A clean draft is a test too: flagging a good line costs points and a colleague's goodwill. This list names the real dependencies (DPO, works council, time, trust, IT) and gives each a mitigation someone can act on.
